The Philosophy

More than a gift.
A blessing.

In Indian homes, a gift has never been only an object. It is a wish for prosperity, a new beginning honoured, a bond acknowledged.

Aashirwadam gives that tradition a contemporary form: richly detailed presentation boxes and refined gold and silver plated devotional pieces, presented so the blessing is felt before the box is opened.
